info.name: Myconid (2024)
info.description: The Myconid species from Artyom's Adaptable Arsenal updated to 2024 rules.

description.p: Silent and ever-growing, myconids spread through the release of spores, giving rise to clusters of fungi—some of which mature into sentient beings. Their forms vary wildly, from tiny sprouting caps to towering fungal guardians. Bound by an unseen network, they communicate in hushed spores, forming tightly woven colonies that thrive in the deep, damp places of the world.
As a Myconid, you have these special traits.
Darkvision. You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.
Fungal Form. You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition. You also have Resistance to Poison damage.

Pheromone Spores. As a Bonus Action, you can expend one use of this trait to cover one creature that you can see within 60 feet of you with scented spores. For 1 minute, you and all other myconids and spore servants have Advantage on attack rolls against that creature. You can use this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

Rapport Spores. You can communicate telepathically with any creature you can see within 30 feet of you, provided the creature has an Intelligence score of 2 or higher. To understand each other, you and the creature must share a language. The creature can't be an Undead, Construct, or Elemental.
